Alberta is a member of the UFS (DSO) and is a Dark Elf.

She appears in multiple events of Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena and is known as one of the Fuuma 7, loyal and close members.



Personality
Alberta is a confident and strong-willed person, though able to show mercy. Very experienced and mature.

Able to put her foot down and has acting abilities. She doesn't dislike humans as other Dark Elves and is flexible with alliances, as long as they ensure her revenge. Alberta feels guilt over the death of her brother, that was turned into a Ghoul and wishes to kill the vampire responsible, Maisie. Otherwise, she's loving, if a bit of jealous, something that even Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) is worried about at times.

After she is broken and changes alliances, she becomes more sultry and is loyal to Kotaro but her desire to kill Maisie has not changed and only her trust in Kotaro can overcome it later on, stating that her heart is too small to have both hate and love in her.

Alberta, at times, is called Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) and regardless of his fear, understanding of his multiple women, even if she comes in conflict with Chigasaki Ririko.


Appearance
She has blue skin, gray/silver hair and a large bust, as other demons she has pointed ears.

History
Background
A Dark Elf which lived in the forests of the Dark World, together with her brother as part of a lower Demon Tribe.

Oppressed by powerful demons for many years, her chastity was protected by her brother, which was a brilliant warrior. However, one day, the Vampire Maisie attacked the area. Pleading for the life of her brother, Maise transformed him sadistically into a ghoul, and Alberta was forced to kill him. Alberta was left alive, but Alberta swore revenge.

Joining the UFS, she used her natural ability for accuracy to become a sniper, hoping to one day aim at Maisie. She became part of the DSO, to help the development of weapons against demons.

Timeline TABA
She later was captured on a mission trying to attack Maisie, and was trained to become a slave prostitute.

Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) which infiltrated Maisie's ranks, used his own men to train Alberta. Making her join him, under the condition that Kotaro would take out Maisie or allow Alberta a chance to do so. She would work at brothels, as a sleeper agent, gaining intel on both Nomad and other groups like the Incubus Faction. However, she was still far from loyal. After learning, that Task Force G came after Kotaro's life from one of her costumers, Alberta refused to inform Kotaro. Only leaking the info to the Masked Taimanin, with the intel reaching the Fuuma Organization. Kotaro made his way to Alberta, but she remained stubborn and tight-lipped, because in her eyes he had betrayed their contract, as Maisie was still alive.

Kotaro relents for now, and rests for the night, however he again is attacked by G forces. Alberta herself had been captured as by a powerful G agent and was used as bait to smoke Kotaro out into a trap. Thanks to Igawa Sakura (ZERO) support, the group is able to kill the agent "Falco" of G and save Alberta. Having a change of heart, she gave him further information, her source called "Hirai" had been under the protection of the Taimanin Shido Rinka in the past. It is implied that this "Hirai" either was a contact or Fuuma Danjo himself. Which, lead Kotaro much later to the discovery of his father, Danjo.

In a later event, as part of the Fuuma Tokiko rescue mission, she used the cover name of "Cynthia" to work at brothels of the Incubus Faction, and learned the location of the Incubus Base, which had been used by G to hide Tokiko. Thanks to her and others, Tokiko could be rescued.

At a much later point, Alberta goes rogue and refuses to wait any longer, Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) tries to keep her in line with words, but this fails, as Alberta makes her way to kill Maisie. However, Kotaro had planned to brainwash Maisie and gain intel on Nomad, so he worked out a plan to calm Alberta. Using Youjuin Sayaka, to block one of Alberta's bullets and effect her with her calming Ninja Art. As a result, Alberta's desire for revenge was calmed for the next weeks enough for her to overcome it on her own, as Maisie becomes a sleeper agent for the Fuuma Organization.

Overtime, Alberta became so important in the Fuuma Organization and gets known as one of the Fuuma 7, she was given control over a small dark city with a lot of brothels. Her more recent frustration being that Kotaro tended to be too busy to visit. She also is mentioned more often, sometimes referred to as Kotaro's lover, regardless of her being one of many, something he does not deny in his mind.

Alberta later on protects Kotaro on another mission from a number of soldiers, when he hunted by Clone Asagi before his final confrontation with his father Danjo. She also assisted to find out the truth of Olivia Belew, and is seen to supporting Iris Wizard 14 in her personal search.

Alberta is also part of a Christmas party, in which she and other girls, including Igawa Sakura (ZERO), Chigasaki Ririko and Lark Shasha try to invite Kotaro for a private party in their bedrooms. While Kotaro is distracted with Lilith Abel Bindernagel, Alberta takes care of her and surprises Kotaro by not being jealous, and even granting Igawa Sakura (ZERO) "dips" as she worked hard on her "evil costume".

Alberta also joined the final attack on Nomad's headquarters, some members tried to buy out Alberta with information on Maisie's location, but Alberta remained loyal to the Fuuma Organization and moved her personal grudges aside for Kotaro. Her last appearance is in the epilogue world, in which she bumps heads Chigasaki Ririko.

Timeline RPGX
Still part of the DSO, she can support the Independent Rangers.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Sniper Rifle

Accuracy: She is an amazing mark's woman, strengthened also by her elves blood.
Special Rifle: Her rifle uses Taima Particles to be effective against vampires and other demons.
